input.value: Fire caused by grease flare-up on stove while sauteing onions; extinguished with fire extinguisher
Charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls
Localized to kitchen; rest of house unaffected

input.rationale: Fire caused direct damage to kitchen cabinets and smoke damage to ceiling and walls, which is a clear property damage claim covered under homeowners insurance.

Localized kitchen fire with charring of cabinets and smoke damage to ceiling and walls, but contained to one room with no injury. Damage appears significant but not catastrophic. Well within the $250,000 coverage limit; $500 deductible applies.

input.claim_summary: Kitchen fire from grease flare-up on stove; charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries. Damage contained to kitchen. Covered under homeowners policy with $500 deductible and $250,000 limit.
